form:FormGroup.label: Schedule Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: New name for the schedules. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Enables or disables the schedules. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Node
form:FormGroup.helpText: Node that runs the schedules; a schedule only ever runs on the node it names. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Schedules run only on this node. Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Schedule
form:FormGroup.helpText: When the schedules run: Instant, Cron or Frequency. Running every minute or more often is not allowed. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must run less often than once a minute. Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Start Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Effective time of the first run, for schedules that have not run yet; schedules that have already run are not affected. Enter an ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: First run time for schedules not yet run. Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: End Time (Optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: No runs are made with an effective time after this. Leave blank for no end. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank for no end. Applied only if its tick box is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Run As User
form:FormGroup.helpText: User whose permissions the schedules run with. The change is refused if you are not allowed to run as that user. Only applied when this field's tick box is ticked, to the selected or the filtered schedules depending on the button used.
